messages.subject: Hover over w description
parts:
Hi - 

In Shiny, is there a hover-over feature where a user can hover their mouse over a section in the sidepanel of UI that renders popup messages with further description? 

e.g. I have some complex parameter inputs to control a model in the sidepanel of UI, and I want to be able to explain the definition of each input in depth with a mouse hover over the parameter title of each input - without cluttering the UI. 

Thanks,
Ed

messages.subject: Re: Hover over w description
parts: Check out the shinyBS package. It will let you make tooltips and popovers that do this.
